about: Phase 1 (powers of tau) of Neuro's zkML setup: NOT made by ZETAPHY. The Perpetual Powers of Tau (BN254, 80+ independent contributors 2019-2023, coordinated by the Ethereum Foundation's Privacy & Scaling Explorations team), contribution 0080, beacon applied, prepared for phase 2 and truncated to 2^15 by PSE. Pinned by sha256 and blake2b-512: lib.js getPtau() refuses any other bytes. See docs/future/onchain-ml.md (zkML ceremony) for how the pin was checked.
name: Perpetual Powers of Tau, contribution 0080 (PSE), prepared for phase 2, power 15

alternative.about: Hermez/Polygon's prepared file, whose blake2b-512 is published in the snarkjs README (shipped inside the pinned snarkjs 0.7.6 npm package). Its bucket answered 403 from here on 2026-10-29, so it is not the default; to use it, set file/url/bytes/sha256/blake2b from it after checking its blake2b against the README.
